conversation_before.text: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I think I might have lost my wallet with both of my debit cards in it. I have two checking accounts with you — my Bluest Account and my Light Green Account. I’ve been looking everywhere and I can’t find my wallet. I’m not 100% sure it’s gone but I’m getting worried about both cards.

{"message":"I’m sorry you’re dealing with this — I can help secure your cards right away. You have two main options: 

• Temporary freeze (recommended if you’re not sure the wallet is gone): stops new transactions immediately and can be reversed later. Pending authorizations may still post. 

• Permanent close (recommended if you’re sure the cards are lost/stolen): cards are deactivated permanently and cannot be reactivated; you can order replacement cards (we’ll review delivery speed/fees). 

I can also check whether you have any Rho‑Bank credit cards in the wallet and offer replacement protection if needed. 

If you’d like me to take any action (freeze or close cards, check for credit cards, or order replacements), I first need to verify your identity. Please provide any TWO of the following exactly as we have on file: date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY), the email on file, the phone number on file, or your mailing address. 

Which would you like to do now — freeze both cards, close both cards and order replacements, or just discuss next steps? If you prefer not to verify here, I can explain how to freeze cards from the mobile app or transfer you to a human agent."}

Yes, please freeze BOTH cards right away. That way if someone finds my wallet they can’t use either card. I’ll keep looking.

For verification, here are two items exactly as on file:
- Date of birth: 04/12/2002  
- Phone number: 312-555-0847
